Extracts the contour lines of a raster, at regular intervals of its values, as a vector of lines.

**Toolbox folder:** Vector Processing<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** Contours, Isolines, Raster, Vector<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.ContourExtractor`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inCoverage` | raster file |  |  | The raster of which to extract the contours. |
| `pMin` | Double |  |  | The value of the lowest contour. |
| `pMax` | Double |  |  | The value of the highest contour. |
| `pInterval` | Double |  |  | The interval between the contours. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outGeodata` | output file |  | The vector of the contour lines, with their value. |
